title: Administrative services are exposed to the public internet
remediation_summary: Restrict SSH and RDP exposure with private access paths, VPN, or just-in-time controls.
mapping: CIS Azure Foundations Benchmark 6.1; ISO 27001 A.8.20; Cyber Essentials Firewalls; FCA SYSC 3.2.6R

title: Privileged role assignments without MFA enforcement
remediation_summary: Require MFA and admin-focused conditional access for privileged identities.
mapping: CIS Azure Foundations Benchmark 1.4; ISO 27001 A.5.17; NIST PR.AA-02; Cyber Essentials Access control; UK GDPR Article 32; FCA SYSC 3.2.6R

title: Public storage access increases data exposure risk
remediation_summary: Disable anonymous or public storage access and review data exposure paths.
mapping: GDPR Article 32; ISO 27001 A.8.12; UK GDPR Article 32

title: IoT Hub public network access is not sufficiently constrained
remediation_summary: Restrict IoT Hub public access using IP filters, private endpoints, or documented clinical network boundaries.
mapping: NCSC CAF B4 System security; NHS DSPT Network security; Cyber Essentials Firewalls

title: Network security group rules are broader than expected
remediation_summary: Tighten overly permissive network rules to least-privilege source and port scopes.
mapping: CIS Azure Foundations Benchmark 6.1; NIST PR.AC-05; Cyber Essentials Firewalls

title: Critical workloads remain unpatched beyond acceptable risk tolerance
remediation_summary: Patch critical workloads and enforce a stronger recurring patch policy.
mapping: Microsoft Cloud Security Benchmark PV-6; NIST PR.PS-03; Cyber Essentials Security update management; DSPT NDG Standard 6

title: Data stores lack expected encryption protections
remediation_summary: Enable encryption at rest for affected storage and database services.
mapping: ISO 27001 A.8.24; NIST PR.DS-01; UK GDPR Article 32

title: Private endpoint coverage is incomplete for sensitive services
remediation_summary: Extend private endpoints to sensitive services that should not rely on public routing.
mapping: Microsoft Cloud Security Benchmark NS-2; NIST PR.AC-03

title: IoT shared access policies exceed least-privilege expectations
remediation_summary: Reduce IoT shared access policies, remove overbroad permissions, and rotate keys through governed operations.
mapping: NCSC CAF B2 Identity and access control; NHS DSPT Security management; IEC 62443 account management

title: Cloud device-identity registration posture is weak or unobservable
remediation_summary: Inventory cloud-registered IoMT device identities and prefer certificate-based authentication for clinical device connections while validating device-side credential storage separately.
mapping: NCSC CAF B2 Identity and access control; NHS DSPT Access control; IEC 80001-1 risk management

title: Endpoint protection coverage is below the expected workload baseline
remediation_summary: Deploy endpoint protection or security agents to uncovered workloads.
mapping: Microsoft Cloud Security Benchmark LT-4; NIST PR.PS-01; Cyber Essentials Malware protection

title: Workload hardening baseline coverage is incomplete
remediation_summary: Apply a hardened workload baseline across compute resources and administrative settings.
mapping: CIS Controls 4.1; NIST PR.IP-01

title: Backup and retention coverage fall below resilience expectations
remediation_summary: Increase backup and retention coverage for business-critical data stores.
mapping: ISO 27001 A.8.13; NIST PR.DS-04; DSPT NDG Standard 7

title: Security monitoring coverage is below the expected baseline
remediation_summary: Expand security monitoring coverage across workloads and key cloud services.
mapping: Microsoft Cloud Security Benchmark LT-1; NIST DE.CM-02

title: Workload backup agent coverage is below resilience expectations
remediation_summary: Enable workload backup protections for critical virtual machines and services.
mapping: ISO 27001 A.8.13; NIST PR.DS-04

title: Activity log retention is below governance and investigation expectations
remediation_summary: Increase log retention to support investigation, governance review, and evidence preservation.
mapping: CIS Azure Foundations Benchmark 5.2; NIST DE.CM-01; DSPT NDG Standard 6

title: Policy assignment coverage is below the baseline governance threshold
remediation_summary: Increase baseline policy assignment coverage for governance and compliance controls.
mapping: Azure Policy Baseline; NIST GV.PO-01

title: Stale service principals or credentials require review
remediation_summary: Rotate or remove stale service principal credentials and disable unused identities.
mapping: Microsoft Cloud Security Benchmark IM-3; NIST PR.AA-01

title: Conditional private endpoint and network isolation posture is weak
remediation_summary: Deploy private endpoints for sensitive IoMT telemetry services where public routing lacks documented and observable compensating controls.
mapping: NCSC CAF B4 System security; NHS DSPT Network security; UK GDPR Article 32

title: IoT credential governance is not linked to managed secret controls
remediation_summary: Store and rotate IoT credentials through governed key-management services with owner accountability.
mapping: NCSC CAF B2 Identity and access control; NHS DSPT Access control; ISO 27001 A.8.24

title: IoT diagnostic logging is incomplete for clinical telemetry investigation
remediation_summary: Enable IoT Hub diagnostic settings and route core diagnostic categories to a monitored destination.
mapping: NCSC CAF C1 Security monitoring; NHS DSPT Logging and monitoring; ISO 27001 A.8.15

title: Defender for IoT or equivalent security monitoring is not evidenced
remediation_summary: Enable Defender for IoT or document an equivalent monitoring path for clinical IoT assets.
mapping: NCSC CAF C1 Security monitoring; NHS DSPT Security operations; IEC 62443 security monitoring

title: IoMT telemetry routing and retention are below clinical evidence expectations
remediation_summary: Route IoMT telemetry to governed storage and retain sufficient logs for investigation and clinical safety review.
mapping: NCSC CAF C1 Security monitoring; NHS DSPT Records management; ISO 27001 A.8.15

title: Clinical IoT alert routing is not operationally evidenced
remediation_summary: Create IoT-specific alert rules and route them to accountable clinical or operational responders.
mapping: NCSC CAF C2 Proactive security event discovery; NHS DSPT Incident management; IEC 80001-1 operational risk

title: Orphaned resources increase governance and cost hygiene risk
remediation_summary: Review and remove unused or orphaned resources to reduce cost and governance noise.
mapping: Azure CAF Governance Discipline; FinOps Asset Hygiene

title: Budget alerting is not enabled for cloud cost governance
remediation_summary: Configure budget thresholds and spend alerts for cost oversight.
mapping: FinOps Cost Governance; ISO 27001 A.5.36

title: Clinical-operational ownership boundaries require human validation
remediation_summary: Document clinical, operational, and supplier ownership boundaries for IoMT assets and validate device-level evidence manually.
mapping: NCSC CAF A1 Governance; NHS DSPT Leadership and governance; IEC 80001-1 responsibility agreements

title: Identity governance observability is partial for this assessment scope
remediation_summary: Broaden tenant-level identity evidence collection before treating IAM coverage as complete.
mapping: ISO 27001 A.5.15; NIST GV.RM-01
